subject.title: fix(ui): avoid fallback main session parent in Control UI

question: Should Control UI accept bare `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` as session-naming shortcuts, or should naming stay behind `/name` or explicit `/new --name` syntax?
rationale: The implementation now follows the existing label contract, but it intentionally changes user-facing command semantics that overlap the merged `/name` command and documented `/new [model]` behavior.

options.title: Keep Control UI shortcuts on label
options.body: Land the Control UI shortcuts on the existing `label` contract with the docs note explaining the surface-specific behavior.

options.title: Require explicit naming syntax
options.body: Change named new-session creation to `/new --name <title>` or keep `/label` only as an alias for `/name`.

options.title: Defer to broader command work
options.body: Pause this PR and resolve named `/new`, close/delete, and cross-channel command semantics through the broader command PR.

recommendation.title: Keep Control UI shortcuts on label
recommendation.body: Land the Control UI shortcuts on the existing `label` contract with the docs note explaining the surface-specific behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the dashboard session flow and merged the accepted `/name` command path that defines the adjacent UX contract.
